description: This file defines internal constants and a generic class 'Interner' for managing a weakly-referenced cache of interned objects, aimed at optimizing garbage collection and memory usage in a .NET application, specifically within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: InternerConstants
classes.description: Contains predefined cache size constants used by the Interner class, optimized for different memory and performance scenarios.

classes.name: Interner<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: A sealed class providing a weakly-referenced cache for interned objects, designed to optimize garbage collection by reusing object instances and managing memory efficiently.

methods.name: Interner
methods.description: Constructor initializing the intern cache with a specified initial size and setting up a periodic cleanup timer.

methods.name: FindOrCreate
methods.description: Retrieves a cached object by key or creates and caches a new one if it does not exist, using a creator function.

methods.name: FindOrCreate (overload)
methods.description: Retrieves a cached object by key or creates and caches a new one with additional state passed to the creator function.

methods.name: InternCacheCleanupTimerCallback
methods.description: Callback method invoked periodically to remove entries from the cache whose target objects have been garbage collected.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the internal timer to stop periodic cleanup.
